week_note: Week 4 is played and Week 5 is next. Every game of Week 4 has a final score in the schedule, and no game of Week 5 does, so Week 5 is the week being played. Season production and every rate covers weeks 1–4. CAR, KC are on bye, so their players carry no projection for this week. Betting lines exist through Week 6, about one week ahead, which is why defenses beyond that have no market-based projection.

week_source.rule: earliest week with any game lacking a final score; a week whose Thursday game is final but whose Sunday and Monday games are not is still the current week

dst.scoring: 1 sack, 2 INT, 2 fumble rec, 1 forced fumble, 6 TD, 2 safety, 2 block, PA tiers
dst.projection: opponent implied total from the betting line (total/2 +/- spread/2), integrated across the points-allowed tiers rather than taking the tier of the mean, plus sack and takeaway rates shrunk toward league average over 4 games of prior

proj_note: Projected stat lines for Week 5 came from Sleeper's own projections, pulled one position at a time with player ids excluded and matched to the player database by name and position — the relay that reaches Sleeper corrupts ids but not names. 245 players carry a feed line; 489 carry a model line, marked ~. Both are stat lines, so both score through this league's own table; only a feed line is a projection. Where the weekly consensus covers this same week it is the model's baseline, which is what keeps a player the feed omitted because he is not playing from being modelled as a starter. Defenses price off the Week 5 betting lines.

variance.method: pooled within-player weekly standard deviation, 2026 to date
variance.form: sigma = intercept + slope * projected points, floored

checked: each roster's own player and starter counts match its list
every starter is on that roster
at least 95% of ids match the player database

scoring_note: Re-read from Sleeper this run: 44 keys, byte-for-byte the same values as the previous build. Nothing a commissioner could have changed has changed.

kickoff_check.rule: gameday+gametime are America/New_York wall clock, converted to UTC with zoneinfo; end = kick + 190 minutes
kickoff_check.dst_ends: 2026-11-01, so weeks 1–8 kick at 00:15Z Friday and weeks 9–17 at 01:15Z Friday
